findings.title: 42 track segment(s) below the 0.127 mm fab minimum
findings.detail: Narrowest track: 0.100 mm. Over-etching on thin tracks causes opens and lower yield.
findings.recommendation: Widen tracks to at least 0.159 mm where space allows, or choose a fab profile that supports them.

findings.title: 30 copper item(s) closer than 0.30 mm to the board edge
findings.detail: Routing/scoring exposes or burrs copper that sits this close to the edge (shorts to enclosure, delamination).
findings.recommendation: Pull copper back to >= 0.38 mm from Edge.Cuts or ask the fab for edge plating.

findings.title: 43 feature(s) break Eurocircuits process limits
findings.detail: outer track width: 42 (worst 0.1 vs 0.125); outer copper gap: 1 (worst 0.12 vs 0.125).
findings.recommendation: These limits apply to every class of Eurocircuits pattern + drill classes.

findings.title: No fiducials on the top side (48 SMD parts)
findings.detail: Pick-and-place machines need >= 2 global fiducials per populated side for accurate placement.
findings.recommendation: Add 2-3 fiducials in opposite corners of the top side, or confirm that the panel rails carry them.

findings.title: No fiducials on the bottom side (1 SMD parts)
findings.detail: Pick-and-place machines need >= 2 global fiducials per populated side for accurate placement.
findings.recommendation: Add 2-3 fiducials in opposite corners of the bottom side, or confirm that the panel rails carry them.

findings.title: 5 small part(s) with unbalanced pad heating
findings.detail: One pad heats much slower than the other (solid plane, wide track or via); surface tension then lifts the part on end during reflow (tombstoning/open joint).
findings.recommendation: Use thermal reliefs on the plane connection and equal-width tracks on both pads.

findings.title: 91 via(s) inside SMD pads
findings.detail: Open vias in pads wick solder away from the joint (starved joints, voids) unless they are filled and capped.
findings.recommendation: Move vias next to the pad (dog-bone) or order filled & capped vias (IPC-4761 type VII).

findings.title: 2 power net(s) cannot be probed
findings.detail: Rails without probe access cannot be verified on the production tester.
findings.recommendation: Add a >= 0.9 mm test pad on the top side for each listed rail.

findings.title: 20 acute track junction(s) (< 80 deg)
findings.detail: Acute copper angles trap etchant and can over-etch, creating thin necks.
findings.recommendation: Re-route the junctions with 45/90 degree entries.

findings.title: 4 copper item(s) close to the board edge
findings.detail: Between 0.30 and 0.38 mm from the edge.
findings.recommendation: Add margin where cheap to do so.

findings.title: 25 plated hole pad(s) with annular ring close to the minimum
findings.detail: Rings within 25% of the fab limit.
findings.recommendation: Enlarge pads where possible.

findings.title: 676 track segment(s) close to the 0.127 mm fab minimum
findings.detail: Narrowest track: 0.150 mm. Over-etching on thin tracks causes opens and lower yield.
findings.recommendation: Widen tracks to at least 0.159 mm where space allows, or choose a fab profile that supports them.

findings.title: 1 component(s) within 0.5 mm of (or over) the edge
findings.detail: Parts at the edge collide with panel rails, conveyor clamps and depaneling tools.
findings.recommendation: Keep courtyards >= 3.0 mm inside the outline or add breakaway rails.

findings.title: 8 fine-pitch (<= 0.5 mm) part(s)
findings.detail: Fine pitch raises the risk of solder bridges and insufficient joints.
findings.recommendation: Use a <= 0.12 mm stencil with reduced apertures, solder-mask dams between pads and AOI after reflow.

findings.title: 1 flex-sensitive part(s) within 3 mm of mounting holes
findings.detail: Screw torque bends the board locally and cracks MLCCs / BGA joints.
findings.recommendation: Keep MLCCs and area-array packages away from screws or use standoffs with washers.

findings.title: 4 connector(s) without through-hole anchors
findings.detail: Mating forces and cable strain go straight into SMD solder joints; pads rip off after repeated use.
findings.recommendation: Use connector variants with through-hole shell tabs/pegs, or add an enclosure strain relief.

findings.title: 1 external connector(s) with unprotected signal lines
findings.detail: ESD at user-accessible connectors is a top cause of field returns (latent damage, not caught by test).
findings.recommendation: Add TVS/ESD diodes close to the connector (e.g. USBLC6 for USB, low-capacitance arrays for data lines).

findings.title: 1 power net(s) contain tracks narrower than 0.30 mm
findings.detail: Thin power tracks drop voltage and heat up; capacity shown is IPC-2221 at 10 C rise (35 um Cu). Set nets.<name>.max_current_a in the config to turn this into a hard check.
findings.recommendation: Widen power tracks where space allows.

findings.title: 3 capacitor(s) on known rails have no voltage rating
findings.detail: Without a rating the derating cannot be verified and purchasing may substitute a low-voltage part.
findings.recommendation: Add a 'Voltage' field (e.g. 16V) to the capacitor symbols.

findings.title: No revision in the board title block
findings.detail: Test results, fixtures and field returns cannot be traced to a board revision.
findings.recommendation: Set the revision in Board Setup > Title block and print it on silkscreen (${REVISION}).

findings.title: Board needs Eurocircuits class 9D (STANDARD pool, Defined impedance, RF pool)
findings.detail: Driven by: component hole annular ring (inner) 0.1 at pattern 8 (limit 0.125); component plated hole (finished) 0.2 at drill C (limit 0.25).
findings.recommendation: Set the class you will order (tech.class) to check the board against its limits.

findings.title: Assembly process: SMT top (48 parts) + SMT bottom (1 parts)
findings.detail: Each extra process step adds cost and handling (handling = flex & ESD exposure).

findings.title: 46 signal net(s) not probed
findings.detail: These nets are not covered by the bed-of-nails test.
findings.recommendation: Add test pads, raise testplan.max_channels, or accept the gap.
